ideas.title: The Impact of Welfare Fraud on Minnesota's Social Services
ideas.description: Investigate how welfare fraud allegations have affected Minnesota's social services and the lives of its citizens.
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of the effects of welfare fraud on Minnesota's social services
questions: How has welfare fraud impacted Minnesota's social services?
What are the consequences for citizens?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the real-world consequences of welfare fraud and the importance of effective governance.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Scope of Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: Investigate the scope and implications of the child care funding freeze in Minnesota and other affected states.
ideas.angle: Data analysis of the funding freeze's impact on child care services
questions: What is the scope of the child care funding freeze?
How will it affect child care services?
ideas.insight: This story could provide critical information for families and policymakers affected by the funding freeze.
